abilities.effect: Each adze sweep deals 10 damage to EVERY plant inside the 1.7 m, 40 degree half-angle frontal cone, not just the targeted one; one bite every 0.8 s (1 sweep per loop, hit on the loop end).
abilities.name: Adze Cleave
abilities.trigger: Plant inside the frontal bite cone, on the bite timer (KimBongCarpenter.gd)

abilities.name: Siege
abilities.trigger: Within 1.3 m of the dais wall (inherited)

clipAnnotations.attack: 0.8 s loop at native 1.0x speed: wind-up to the right, wide horizontal adze sweep to the left; the hit lands at the loop end (0.8 s = bite_interval), the follow-through is the next loop's first frame.
clipAnnotations.die: One-shot 1.6 s: plank slides off the shoulder, collapses forward, shrinks to nothing; then freed.
clipAnnotations.walk: 1.2 s loop at native 1.0x: steady trudge with the plank bobbing on the shoulder.

lore: His adze cleaves through a plant and the one beside it.
mechanism: Cleave: a Hungry Ghost with 100 HP that walks at 0.6 m/s. On each bite tick (10 damage, every 0.8 s) it damages every plant inside its frontal bite cone (eat_range / eat_half_angle_deg), skipping rising, airborne and uneatable ground traps like the base targeting. Walks the Plants group only on the bite tick. All march/seek/siege AI, health bar and materials inherited.
name: Kim Bong Carpenter
traits: Hits every plant in the cone
